channel.title: Epic Fury Live — US-Iran War Tracker
channel.description: Live tracking of the US-Israel-Iran conflict. Real-time updates, verified casualties, evidence, and analysis.

item.title: Four arrested over fatal shooting of South African boxer Zolani Tete
item.description: Tete, who won world WBF flyweight and WBO bantamweight titles, was killed outside his home in Eastern Cape last week.

item.title: South Korea says US cancelled upcoming joint marine exercises over Iran war
item.description: The cancellation follows Trump's surprise order last week to scale back a separate annual joint military drill.

item.title: US threatens toughest sanctions yet against Iran: What we know
item.description: Tehran has threatened to retaliate against any country that joins new US economic measures.

item.title: US military says strike on alleged drug-smuggling boat kills two
item.description: US Southern Command says Sunday's strike targeted vessel operating along established narco-trafficking routes.

item.title: Transfer target Julian Alvarez booed by fans in Atletico Madrid win
item.description: Argentinian striker was targeted by fans while warming up and jeered again after coming on in the 66th minute.

item.title: US threat of ‘economic D-Day’ for Iran tests Trump’s China detente
item.description: Exerting maximum economic pressure on Tehran would risk blowback from Beijing.

item.title: Iran faces 'greatest financial offensive ever', says US treasury secretary
item.description: Scott Bessent says the US will sever all economic ties with the country and that any nation partnering with Iran financially will also be isolated.

item.title: Four arrested over suspected poisoning of elephants in Kenya
item.description: An investigation is looking into whether the deaths were caused by pesticides sprayed on tomato crops.

item.title: France links sharp rise in drownings to heatwaves
item.description: A government minister says people have been taking risks by going into the water, with 301 deaths since 19 June.
